chunks: As for whatever is in it from Al-Faḍl ibn Abī Qurrah Al-Samandī, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah have mercy on him—from ʿAlī ibn Al-Ḥusayn Al-Saʿdābādī, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh Al-Barqī, from Sharīf ibn Sābiq Al-Tiflīsī, from Al-Faḍl ibn Abī Qurrah Al-Samandī.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father; the author's immediate source in this chain
key_terms.التِّفْلِيسِيِّ: Al-Tiflīsī; the attributed nisbah of Sharīf ibn Sābiq
key_terms.السَّمَنْدِيِّ: Al-Samandī; the attributed nisbah of Al-Faḍl ibn Abī Qurrah
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct authorial transmission of the report

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Al-Faḍl ibn Abī Qurrah Al-Samandī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu Al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from Al-Faḍl ibn Abī Qurrah Al-Samandī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu Al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the line of transmission, which is essential in hadith sciences for identifying sources and assessing narrational provenance.
